source.title: Wikipedia: Blast furnace
source.gives: earliest European blast furnaces (Durstel, Maerkische Sauerland, Lapphyttan, 12th-13th c.); first English furnace Queenstock, Buxted, about 1491; zone temperatures to about 1,200 C; Darby coke 1709; 18th c. furnaces about 360 t a year
